register.tip:
Your e-mail address is required only for KOBOOL to contact you for the following purposes:
  1. Password reminder.
  2. Acceptance Matching notification.
  3. Notification for new messages from whom you matched with.
  • Your e-mail will NOT be visible to any visitor or member.
  • You can change this address whenever you want after becoming a member.
  • Please make sure that this address is correct in order to get the full support from us.
